name: agent-pixel-dissolve
prompt: Transition: a pixelated dissolve where blocks of the outgoing layer flip to the incoming one in random order, with a block size slider.

provenance.via: claude --print with the in-app agent instructions (no Powermove MCP tools)

definition.label: Pixel Dissolve

summary: I wrote the Pixel Dissolve transition (`gen.pixel-dissolve`) but haven't compiled or rendered it, because no live Powermove tools were attached to this run. It splits the frame into square blocks, and each block gives up a random value between 0 and 1. A block switches from `u_from` to `u_to` as soon as `u_prog` passes that value, so blocks flip in random order and the change is exact at 0 and 1. There's a Block Size slider (2–400 px, default 40) and an advanced Seed slider; both can be keyframed. One unconfirmed assumption: the docs don't name the coordinates a transition shader receives, so I used the ones effects get — `v_st` for texture sampling and `v_px` for the block grid. If those differ for transitions, compiling it will show it.
